title: Dialogue Manager
summary: Branching dialogue written as .dialogue text files with characters, choices, conditions, variables and function calls, plus a ready-made dialogue balloon UI.
useWhen: The game has NPC conversations, branching choices, quests, shops or story scenes whose lines depend on game state, or more dialogue than fits comfortably in GDScript arrays.
avoidWhen: Only a few fixed lines, signs or tooltips; a Label or a short array of strings in GDScript is simpler.
